sql: SELECT 'historico' AS onde, h.created_at::text AS quando, h.new_value AS detalhe FROM lead_history h WHERE h.action = 'Pedido Vamu 3D' AND h.created_at > now() - interval '2 hours' UNION ALL SELECT 'sininho', n.created_at::text, n.title || ' | ' || n.message || ' | users=' || count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY n.title)::text FROM notifications n WHERE n.type = 'vamu_order' AND n.created_at > now() - interval '2 hours' UNION ALL SELECT 'festa', e.updated_at::text, right(e.internal_notes, 200) FROM company_events e WHERE e.internal_notes ILIKE '%#vamu-%' AND e.updated_at > now() - interval '2 hours'
